item.title: ComfyUI expands to 779 nodes for image, video, and 3D workflows
item.description:
ComfyUI expands to 779 nodes for image, video, and 3D workflows

ComfyUI has grown to include 779 nodes, expanding its capabilities to handle image, video, 3D, and language models along with the plumbing between them. The project has maintained an MIT license since 2023 and has accumulated over a million downloads. Its architecture is designed so that nothing is installed or fetched unless explicitly requested.

🧩 Core Capabilities

The node library supports a wide range of processing tasks, including:

  • Tiled and affine samplers, noise shaping, shift and schedule control, model quantizing, and LoRA stacks.
  • Crop-and-restore edits, edit regions, and specific model integrations like MiniMax H3 Image, Fibo 2.0, and BluePixel 4K.
  • Raw-style develop, film stocks, darkroom effects, and looks baked into LUTs.
  • Levels, LUTs, ACES and colour spaces, linear light, HDR video, and scopes and charts.
  • Skin, face, and subject masks, including masks drawn directly on the picture and subjects followed through a clip.
  • Filters and optics, layer stacks, layered PSD and TIFF files, and ControlNet preprocessors.

🎬 Video and 3D Features

Recent developments extend ComfyUI’s utility into complex video production and 3D generation:

  • Video Production: The Prompt Timeline allows long videos to be built a segment at a time. Features include upscaling, sparse attention, and Pika H3 Flex integration. The system supports video with sound, video super-resolution of any length, edits, transitions, titles, restored footage, face restoration through a shot, audio mixing, and beats.
  • 3D Generation: Capabilities include scenes, generated models, characters, meshes, blockouts, point cloud worlds, and Video Blueprint.

📚 Text and Logic Tools

The platform also includes utilities for prompt engineering and data handling:

  • Prompt terminology and a style library.
  • A system prompt library.
  • Support for text, lists, and dictionaries.

🚀 Availability and Resources

  • License: MIT (since 2023).
  • Downloads: Over a million.
  • Examples: 144 example workflows are provided.
  • Installation Model: Nothing installed, nothing fetched unless asked.

#ComfyUI #AIWorkflows #VideoGeneration #3DGeneration #OpenSource

Source: WASasquatch/was-node-suite-comfyui

item.title: OpenAI, Legal Experts Discuss AI Applications for In-House Legal Teams
item.description:

item.title: AWS Quick Updates Enable Deterministic Multi-Agent Workflows and Desktop Integration
item.description:
AWS Quick Updates Enable Deterministic Multi-Agent Workflows and Desktop Integration

AWS has released updates to AWS Quick, an AI workspace built specifically for work. These updates are designed to help teams complete everyday tasks by allowing users to describe a process in chat, which Quick then builds into a flow that orchestrates agents, skills, and tools with access to structured data, knowledge, and apps.

🧩 How it works

Users can now build, run, and refine flows entirely in chat. The system introduces new deterministic steps to make workflows consistent and verifiable, supporting longer-running processes and large data volumes. With multi-agent orchestration, several specialized agents work on a request simultaneously, and Quick combines their findings into a single response.

Example Workflow: Financial Reporting

The update demonstrates a workflow for Maya, a financial planning and analysis manager, who prepares monthly reports for her VP of Finance. Previously, this process lived in her memory and a personal checklist, meaning teammates had to rebuild the report from scratch when she was out. Quick builds the flow from her description, allowing her to test and refine it in the same conversation. A diagram beside the chat displays each step for verification. The flow performs the following actions:

  • Pulls last month’s results from the team’s monthly results dashboard in Quick.
  • Compares each region to the annual plan in a budget spreadsheet using set formulas to ensure consistent calculations.
  • Flags regions that moved significantly from plan based on user-set thresholds and drafts commentary using a team-specific skill.
  • Drafts a Microsoft Excel summary to a shared Space and report email, and notifies the team in Slack that the draft is ready.

Jordan, an analyst on Maya’s team, can run this flow from the Quick desktop app. The flow can utilize local resources, such as a spreadsheet of regional adjustments saved on his computer. Before the report is finalized, Jordan reviews the draft, asks for changes in chat, and approves it for the VP of Finance.

⚙️ Key details

The updated web app places items needing attention and a daily briefing on the home screen, adds agents and skills used on desktop, and keeps work running after the tab is closed. Quick also supports connections to external tools like Meta ads and Amplitude, allowing users to ask questions in natural language and combine answers with other sources. Language support has expanded to include Japanese, German, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), and Vietnamese.

💡 Why it matters

AWS Quick Flows helps teams automate and standardize business processes. For organizations, this allows data teams to focus on complex, high-impact work. One retailer reported that without growing its team, nearly four times as many people now work with data each month. A single use case already saves 80 hours of work per month, shifting the culture from a few people building solutions to an organization where everyone can create, experiment, and change how they work.

#AWS #AIagents #WorkflowAutomation #Productivity #MultiAgent

Source: New in AWS Quick: More capable flows, an updated web experience, and agents that work together | Amazon Web Services

item.title: Activepieces Updates Open Source AI Automation and MCP Toolkit
item.description:
Activepieces Updates Open Source AI Automation and MCP Toolkit

Activepieces has introduced an all-in-one AI automation platform featuring an extensible, type-safe pieces framework written in TypeScript. The platform offers over 280 open-source pieces available on npmjs.com, with 60% contributed by the community. When contributed, these pieces automatically become available as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for use with LLMs through Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Windsurf.

🛠️ Key Capabilities

  • AI-First Design: Native AI pieces allow users to experiment with various providers or create custom agents using the AI SDK.
  • Developer Experience: Pieces are npm packages written in TypeScript with support for hot reloading during local development.
  • Flow Control & Logic: Includes loops, branches, auto retries, HTTP requests, and code execution with NPM support, alongside an ASK AI in Code Piece feature for data cleaning.
  • Human in the Loop: Execution can be delayed for a period of time, or configured to require approval.
  • Human Input Interfaces: Built-in support for chat and form interface triggers.
  • Enterprise & Security: Self-hosted and network-gapped for maximum security, allowing developers to set up tools for organizational use via a no-coder builder.
  • Additional Features: Fully versioned flows, language translations, and customizable templates.

🌐 Ecosystem and Availability

  • Integrations: Supports integrations with Google Sheets, OpenAI, Discord, RSS, and over 200 other services.
  • Open Source Licensing: The Community Edition is open source under the MIT license, while enterprise features are released under a commercial license.
  • Contributions: Community contributions are supported and published directly to npmjs.com upon contribution.

#Activepieces #TypeScript #MCP #AIAutomation #OpenSource

Source: activepieces/activepieces

item.title: Databricks introduces Skills for Genie One
item.description:
Databricks introduces Skills for Genie One

Databricks has introduced a new feature for Genie One called Skills, which adds a layer of control by defining specific workflow recipes that the agent can follow on demand to ensure consistent formats and outputs.

🧩 How it works

A skill is a durable, reusable asset that serves as a written record of how a team works, using plain language and the open Agent Skills format. Genie One leverages skills either when called directly by the user or when it decides a skill is relevant to the request.

  • Scope and Isolation: Guidance stays with the specific task rather than spilling into other work. Because Genie One only reads the skills it needs, keeping them specific and focused is advantageous for testing, fixing, and reusing them.
  • Chainable Assets: Small skills can be chained together; for example, updating a style guidelines skill once allows every other skill that uses it to pick up the change.
  • Judgment vs. Routines: While dashboards do the same thing every time, skills allow Genie One to make decisions, such as choosing the most important changes for leadership or following unusual results until they make sense.
  • Strict Rules: Skills define what must always appear, what to do when something is missing, and thresholds that decide what gets a closer look. For instance, a trading brief might always include a watch list even if nothing breached a threshold.

⚙️ Key details

Skills distinguish themselves from Genie Agents and Genie Ontology by focusing on the method rather than domain knowledge:

Component Function
Genie Ontology Tells Genie One what things mean.
Genie Agent Domain expert for one area (e.g., sales, finance, HR); knows metric definitions, tables, joins, and business rules.
Skill Recipe for a specific task: the steps, checklist, and output format.

For example, a sales pipeline Genie Agent knows the pipeline tables and stage definitions, while a “weekly forecast risk memo” skill instructs Genie One to compare current and previous pipeline data, flag slipped deals, and produce a one-page memo. The Genie Agent supplies domain knowledge, and the skill supplies the workflow.

💡 Why it matters

You can build a skill directly in Genie One by explaining your workflow in detail once, prompting the agent to interview you before writing the skill. Genie One draws on existing knowledge through Genie Ontology to focus questions on how you work rather than what your data means. Answering in plain language is enough for Genie One to write the skill. Once built, a skill can be published through Unity Gateway and used by any agent that supports MCP, including coding agents teams already use.

Consider using a skill when you find yourself explaining the same thing to Genie One more than once.

#Databricks #GenieOne #AISkills #MCP #WorkflowAutomation

Source: Teach Genie One your workflows: The ultimate guide for skills in Genie One

item.title: Aitino Open-Source Platform Uses Node Editor to Create AI Agent Teams
item.description:
Aitino Open-Source Platform Uses Node Editor to Create AI Agent Teams

Aitino is an open-source platform designed for creating teams of AI Agents to automate high-level tasks and solve complex problems without lengthy and complicated setups.

🔍 Overview

The platform aims to go from a prompt to a solution in a matter of minutes. Users need to provide only required information, such as API keys, context, and specific task details, taking just seconds to configure.

🧩 How it works

  • Node Editor: Aitino features a visual node editor interface, designed to remain simple for small use cases while scaling for highly complex agent teams.
  • Autogen Framework: The platform is built on top of the Autogen Framework.
  • System Integration: Aitino plans to merge principles from other multi-agent projects, such as ChatDev and CrewAI, to support features that are out of reach using Autogen alone.

⚙️ Key details

Source code for the platform is publicly available, and the project actively welcomes contributions and suggestions. Developers interested in paid development opportunities can reach out to join the project. The technology stack powering Aitino includes:

  • Framework: SvelteKit
  • Styling: TailwindCSS
  • Components: shacn-svelte
  • Database: Supabase
  • Payment Processing: Stripe
  • Hosting: Vercel

📅 Release roadmap

Date Release Details
Feb 16 Waitlist Launch Initial waitlist opening
Mar 3 v0.1.0 Release Simple functionality for creating and running a team of AI Agents
Mar 26 v0.2.0 Release Enhanced functionalities including auto-build, applet builder, community features, and multi-modal task solving
Apr 17 v1.0.0 Release First official release with final touches

🚀 Availability

Aitino Web serves as the cloud-hosted version of the platform. A free plan is coming soon to allow users to test the platform’s capabilities.

#Aitino #AIAgents #OpenSource #Autogen #DeveloperTools

Source: startino/aitino

item.title: ServiceNow Launches AI Workflow Factory for Continuous Agentic Workflow Improvement
item.description:
ServiceNow Launches AI Workflow Factory for Continuous Agentic Workflow Improvement

ServiceNow announced the AI Workflow Factory, a platform that turns workflow improvement into a continuous, agentic AI‑powered loop. The announcement also introduced Flow by ServiceNow, an AI service desk that can be deployed instantly, and highlighted new agent‑to‑agent capabilities emerging from collaborations with Work4Flow and LogicMonitor.

🔍 Overview

  • AI Workflow Factory launches to enable a continuous loop of workflow improvement powered by AI agents.
  • Flow by ServiceNow is a new AI service desk that deploys instantly.
  • Work4Flow and LogicMonitor extend Edwin AI investigations in ServiceNow with new agent‑to‑agent capabilities.

🧩 How it works

  • Workflows are continuously analyzed and refined by AI agents, creating an ongoing improvement cycle.
  • The system leverages agentic AI, meaning AI entities act autonomously to identify and apply enhancements.
  • Agent‑to‑agent capabilities allow separate AI components (e.g., Edwin AI, Work4Flow, LogicMonitor) to cooperate on investigations and optimizations.

⚙️ Key details

  • Continuous, self‑optimizing workflow loop.
  • Agentic AI that can act without direct human commands.
  • Instant deployment of the Flow AI service desk.
  • Integration of multiple AI agents for deeper investigations (Edwin AI, Work4Flow, LogicMonitor).

🚀 Availability

  • Flow by ServiceNow can be deployed immediately after announcement.
  • AI Workflow Factory is positioned as a new service offering from ServiceNow.

💡 Why it matters

  • Enables enterprises to keep their processes up‑to‑date automatically.
  • Reduces the manual effort required to monitor and improve workflows.
  • Combines multiple AI agents to broaden investigative reach and accelerate problem resolution.

#ServiceNow #AIWorkflow #AgenticAI #Automation

Source: ServiceNow, Inc. (NOW) latest press releases and corporate news – Yahoo Finance

item.title: Certinia Expands Veda Suite With 14 Autonomous Agents and 135 Tools
item.description:
Certinia Expands Veda Suite With 14 Autonomous Agents and 135 Tools

Certinia has expanded its Veda suite by adding 14 autonomous agents and expanding its Intelligent Actions library to 135 tools.

🧩 How it works

The platform connects and coordinates key processes across the enterprise lifecycle by performing the following actions:

  • Workflow Coordination: It coordinates professional services, customer success, and accounting processes.
  • General Ledger Actions: It executes general ledger actions through Model Context Protocol connections.

⚙️ Key details

The expansion introduces several key updates to the platform’s automation capabilities:

  • Autonomous Agents: The suite now includes 14 new autonomous agents.
  • Intelligent Actions: The system’s tool library has been expanded to a total of 135 tools.
  • Operational Reach: The tools span professional services, customer success, and accounting workflows.
